description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions for managing progressive expansion or batch processing, particularly in a UI context. It provides a controller for batching work in a non-blocking manner using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback, and a React hook to integrate this controller with React component state.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batching work with optional progress callbacks, supporting cancellation and adaptive batch sizing.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the createProgressiveExpandController, managing UI state such as running status and progress, and providing methods to start and cancel batch processing.

ctags.signature: ({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })

ctags.signature: ({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
